idea-plugin.name: Simple Web Component
idea-plugin.description:
Editor support for @dooboostore/simple-web-component templates — the HTML you return from @onConnectedBody / @innerHtml, inside .ts / .js strings and in .html files.

  • Completion for component tags, attributes, @state@, $host., $w., $d.
  • Go to definition (Cmd+Click) and parameter info (Cmd+P) inside templates — $host is typed as your component
  • Hover and type errors inside swc-on-*, {{= }} and @x@
  • SWC syntax highlighting

The language server comes with the library: install @dooboostore/simple-web-component 1.0.58+ in your project and open it. Node.js is taken from Settings → Languages & Frameworks → Node.js, or node on PATH.
